question: Which of the following is the chemical formula of baking soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NaHCO3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NaHCO3** is the chemical formula of baking soda.
 
• Baking soda is also known as **sodium bicarbonate**.
 
• It is commonly used in baking as a **leavening agent**.
 
• When it reacts with an acid, it produces carbon dioxide gas, which helps the dough rise.
 
• Other common uses include **cleaning, deodorizing, and in medical applications** to relieve heartburn and acid indigestion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Na2CO3.10H2O** is the chemical formula for washing soda, also known as sodium carbonate decahydrate.
 
• **NaOH** is the chemical formula for sodium hydroxide, commonly known as caustic soda or lye.
 
• **CaOCl2** is the chemical formula for bleaching powder, also known as calcium oxychloride.
 
• Baking soda is different from baking powder, which contains baking soda along with an acidifying agent and a drying agent.
